value.answer: Mostly dry during the day. Environment Canada's forecast from this morning has Monday mainly cloudy, high around 23°C, with no rain in the daytime. The rain holds off until tonight, when a few showers are expected to start before morning, with a chance of a thunderstorm. The Weather Network has only a 20% chance of a shower around 6 to 7pm.
